params.execution_note: This request has three independent workstreams. Dispatch them in parallel as required by the ai-data-bus SOP, then merge evidence without deciding disputed values. questions: Workstream A - artifact integrity correction. Reopen all six files under work-req-20261012-001 and recompute exact raw-byte size and SHA-256. Return a new immutable corrected integrity manifest; do not overwrite old artifacts. Recompute crosswalk totals by season directly from its rows and state definitions for source_row_resolved, SFL Spielnummer matched, date conflict, and unmatched. Reconcile the receipt summary (which says excluded_and_anomaly_rows.csv is 1866 bytes) with the actual artifact and report each discrepancy. Keep date conflicts and unmatched fixtures explicit. Include raw-byte hashes, row counts, retrieval/creation timestamps, and the source URLs/locators used.

Workstream B - formal source and pre-match Context evidence. For every fixture in the 1,584-row eight-season crosswalk, find reproducible pre-kickoff standings/Method Context evidence. Include fixture key, official fixture ID, season, official local kickoff, timezone and DST/UTC conversion, home/away ranks and points, played/W/D/L, exact input matches included, tie-group exclusions, source URL, retrieval timestamp, source locator, and SHA-256. Include the source data files, transformation code/version, and a reproducible audit. Also provide season-level team_count, phases/groups, regular-season boundaries, official round if explicitly published, and meeting_number only when sourced; otherwise retain null with evidence. Do not use post-match facts to reconstruct pre-match context. Return unresolved_queue entries for every missing or conflicting fixture/field. Do not infer official_round or meeting_number from row order or phase.

Workstream C - historical opening 1X2 odds. Search independent archives for exact pre-kickoff opening odds for the same 1,584 fixtures, prioritizing Pinnacle and Bet365 and recording bookmaker-specific semantics. Each record must include fixture key/official ID, bookmaker, home/draw/away opening values, quote timestamp or explicit timestamp_unavailable, source URL, retrieval timestamp, locator, and SHA-256. Keep closing odds in separate fields and never relabel closing or an unspecified single snapshot as opening. Where opening data is absent, search for two distinct independent pre-kickoff endpoints suitable for O_INTERVAL and return both endpoint times and values; otherwise mark unavailable with source-specific reason. Include an expected/discovered/complete/partial/missing audit by season and a conflict queue.

Return a structured report with separate audit and unresolved_queue sections for A, B, and C, plus immutable artifacts and an integrity manifest. Do not make Qimen/palace/five-element/model-direction/Gold/Outcome/Review judgments. Do not change formal Snapshot, Outcome, Review, Gold, probabilities, weights, or existing reports. Muse is an evidence collector; preserve conflicts and nulls. Do not include credentials or secrets.
